audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect line says it: the page never names Granite Shield, Seismic Shard, Thunderclap or Ground Slam anywhere. Worse, it repeats that his armour 'does nothing' against you.
audit.why: Ground Slam is a flat 7s at 400 range that deals magic damage SCALING WITH HIS ARMOR and cuts your attack speed — every armour item he buys is also damage aimed at you, which is the opposite of what the page says. Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges when he has not been hit, so an opening Obliterate into a full shield is wasted. Seismic Shard is a flat 8s at 625 range and steals your move speed for 3s rather than merely slowing. Thunderclap is a 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s auto reset. Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s against your 140/120/100 — he gets it back first.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and whys[3] now name the abilities with their real cooldowns and correct the armour claim.

notes: Largest sample in the slice (2231 games). Two real problems. (1) Three chart rows disagreed with the packet across both layers. (2) The page repeats in four places that Malphite's armour 'does nothing' / is 'dead weight' against you — Ground Slam deals magic damage that scales with his armour on a flat 7s, so his armour is also his damage. I corrected the claim where the length band allowed; the same line survives in wants.you[0], content.early and content.mid and wants an unconstrained rewrite pass. The page also never named four of his five abilities, which the packet had already flagged.
